# ProjectDVC 2.0 — Plan 2: Voice (TTS + Lip-Sync + STT)

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: superpowers:subagent-driven-development. Steps use checkbox syntax.

**Goal:** The companion speaks every reply (ElevenLabs → edge-tts → Piper chain with quota fallback), lip-syncs while talking, and takes microphone input (Groq Whisper) with auto-send.

**Architecture:** Main-process `voice.service.js` arbitrates three TTS providers and writes audio to `data/tts-cache/`; a new `dvc-media://` protocol serves runtime-generated files to the renderer (dev AND prod). Renderer owns playback + lip-sync state machine via a single `<audio>` element. STT: renderer captures mic via getUserMedia/MediaRecorder → ArrayBuffer over IPC → main posts multipart to Groq → text back → existing send flow.

**Tech Stack:** One new dep: `msedge-tts` (edge-tts port for Node). ElevenLabs via plain fetch (no SDK). Piper via child_process spawn. Web Audio / MediaRecorder in renderer.

**Spec:** docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-23-electron-rebuild-design.md §3.3 voice.service, §4.3 lip-sync state machine.

## Global Constraints

- Plain JS; ONE new dependency allowed (`msedge-tts`). No TypeScript.
- All existing tests stay green (170 at start). TDD for service logic.
- New persisted keys — SAVE_KEYS += `lip_sync_tts`(true), `lip_sync_text`(false); SETTINGS_KEYS += `tts_config` object `{enabled:false, engine:'edge', edge_voice:'en-US-AriaNeural', piper_voice:'', stt_engine:'groq', stt_model:'whisper-large-v3-turbo'}`. ElevenLabs creds: SETTINGS_KEYS += `elevenlabs` `{api_key:'', voice_id:'', model_id:'eleven_flash_v2_5'}`.
  (Legacy nested `tts` object was dropped in migration — these fresh keys replace it; migration of legacy values NOT required.)
- Emotion→VoiceSettings map ported verbatim from `legacy/audio/tts_elevenlabs.py::EMOTION_SETTINGS` (18 emotions).
- Text cleaning before synthesis (port legacy): strip `*actions*`, strip `[...]` tags, strip non-speech chars; empty after cleaning → skip silently.
- Fallback chain: ElevenLabs (if engine==='elevenlabs' && configured) → on quota/auth error (401/402/403/429) fall to edge → piper → failed. engine==='edge' → edge only. engine==='piper' → piper only.
- `talking` stays transient — lip-sync toggles it, never persists.
- Preload allowlist: add invoke `voice:stt-transcribe`, push `tts` already exists. `voice:speak`/`voice:stop` already allowlisted.

### Task A: TTS providers + voice service + media protocol + auto-speak

**Files:** Create `src/main/providers/tts/elevenlabs.js`, `edge.js`, `piper.js`, `src/main/services/voice.service.js`, `src/main/media-protocol.js`. Modify `src/main/index.js`, `src/main/ipc.js`, `src/preload/api.js`, `src/main/data/defaults.js`. Tests: `tests/voice.test.js`.

- [ ] Providers — each: `synthesize({text, emotion, outPath, cfg}) → Promise<outPath>`
  - elevenlabs.js: fetch POST `https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id}?output_format=mp3_44100_128`, headers `xi-api-key`, body `{text, model_id, voice_settings: EMOTION_SETTINGS[emotion] ?? neutral}`; write stream to outPath; classify HTTP 401/402/403/429 → throw `VoiceQuotaError` (message includes status).
  - edge.js: `msedge-tts` → mp3 at outPath; voice from cfg.edge_voice.
  - piper.js: spawn piper binary (`piper` on linux, `piper.exe` win — check `process.platform`), args `--model <voice> --output_file <outPath>`, write text to stdin, await exit; missing binary/voice → throw friendly error.
- [ ] voice.service.js — `createVoiceService({ rootDir, config })` → `{ speak({text, emotion}), stop(), scanPiperVoices(), isConfigured() }`
  - speak: clean text → skip if empty → outPath `data/tts-cache/tts_<n>.mp3|wav` (rotating counter 0-9, overwrite oldest) → arbitration chain per Global Constraints → returns `{path, emotion}`; emits via bus topic `tts:ready` {path, emotion}; on total failure emits `tts` {error} — never throws to caller.
  - stop(): no-op placeholder (renderer owns playback stop).
  - scanPiperVoices(): list `assets/tts/voices/*.onnx` stems.
- [ ] media-protocol.js: register `dvc-media://` (protocol.handle) serving ONLY from allowlist roots: `<root>/data/tts-cache` and `<root>/assets`. Path traversal guard (resolve + startsWith check). Register as privileged scheme in index.js before app ready. Renderer converts `dvc-media:///tts-cache/tts_3.mp3` → audio src.
- [ ] ipc.js: `voice:speak {text, emotion}` → voice.speak, ack {queued:true}; auto-speak: in the reply push path, if tts_config.enabled → call voice.speak({text: clean, emotion}) automatically (single place — the same place reply is pushed). `voice:stt-transcribe` in Task C.
- [ ] Tests (inject providers as stubs): cleaning rules; arbitration order + quota fallback (EL throws VoiceQuotaError → edge called → piper not); engine pinning; cache path rotation; protocol path-traversal rejection (pure path fn); EMOTION_SETTINGS map integrity vs legacy (spot-check 5 + count 18).
